attacker_pocs.name: matrix-row-count
attacker_pocs.why: The probe encodes and decodes a valid WebP image, then converts the decoded RGBA pixels through the public SharpYuvConvertWithOptions API to 10-bit YUV. The new matrix scaling check counts three coefficients per row when deriving the number of matrix rows, so its fourth iteration reads beyond the three-entry rows array.

role_a_rationale: The patch validates SharpYuvOptions before dereference, rejects unsupported transfer values, and bounds arithmetic used by the conversion. Ordinary 8-bit sharp-YUV encoding and decoding succeeds. The new coefficient-range check appears to be part of 32-bit overflow prevention, but its row count uses the three scaled color coefficients rather than the four stored matrix entries per row, causing a stack out-of-bounds read on valid mixed-depth conversion. The ASan probe exits 0 on the pinned parent and aborts with status 134 on the patched tree.
